snapshot.text: A national health service (SSN) run by the 21 regions and autonomous provinces, funded through the national health fund. The fund rose from about €126 billion in 2022 to almost €143 billion in 2026, but staff shortages and waiting lists dominate the debate.

priorities.title: Budget 2027: less than asked for
priorities.text: The 2027 budget adds €2.4 billion to the health fund, less than half of the €5.5 billion the minister requested to hire staff and pay doctors and nurses; doctors and regions sounded the alarm.

priorities.title: Health workforce and waiting lists
priorities.text: The minister wants more hiring, better pay and career prospects for health staff, and points to the national waiting-list monitoring platform for reliable data.

priorities.title: Mental health and prevention plans
priorities.text: Italy is implementing its National Mental Health Action Plan 2025-2030 and a 2026-2031 prevention plan, confirmed at a WHO Europe event in the Senate.

netherlands.text: A Dutch-Italian development cooperation page lists sexual and reproductive health and rights among Dutch expertise themes. It does not confirm specific joint health projects with Italy.

institutions.name: Agenas
institutions.role: Regional health services agency, waiting-list monitoring

timeline.text: WHO Europe and Italy strengthen their partnership at an event in the Senate.
GIMBE: the health fund grew by €17.5 billion since 2022 but lags behind GDP growth.
Budget gives €2.4 billion extra for health against €5.5 billion requested.
Minister: health fund to reach €146 billion in 2027.
